scripts.build: turbo build && rm -rf packages/jimmy/dist/web && cp -r packages/web/out packages/jimmy/dist/web
scripts.build:lightsail: pnpm --filter @openryoko/web build && pnpm --filter openryoko... build && rm -rf packages/jimmy/dist/web && cp -r packages/web/out packages/jimmy/dist/web
scripts.test:cloudflare-task-migration: pnpm --filter @openryoko/write-broker test && pnpm --filter @openryoko/task-runtime-core test && pnpm --filter @openryoko/cloudflare-techknight-poc test
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "console.log(JSON.stringify({ node_arch: process.arch, node_version: process.version }))" && playwright test
scripts.typecheck:cloudflare-task-migration: pnpm --filter @openryoko/write-broker typecheck && pnpm --filter @openryoko/task-runtime-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @openryoko/cloudflare-techknight-poc typecheck
scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && node packages/jimmy/dist/bin/jimmy.js start
